backdrop.$description: Full-screen backdrops behind menus and dialogs: the deep purple ground, see-through over the world or solid.

dim.$description: The dim backdrop: the deep purple at 82 % over the world.

deep.$description: The deeper backdrop: the deep purple at 86 % over the world.

night.$description: The opaque night backdrop: the solid deep purple ground.

full-screen.$description: (agent, ui-1.3.0) The opaque ground of the full screens with a Kablammo title (the role reveal, the ends): the soft ink, where the titles' 6 px ink outline and the stickers' hard shadow show; on the deep purple of ToyBackdropNight they vanish (1.00:1).
